literal: For friendship, the exalted seat, what is it if asked? Without wavering, in possible opportunities, the supporting state.
translation: If asked what is the crowning throne of friendship, it is the state of unwavering support in every possible way.
modern: நட்பிற்கு மிகச் சிறந்த நிலை எதுவென்றால், மனம் மாறுபடுதல் இல்லாமல் தம்மால் முடிந்த வழிகளில் எல்லாம் நண்பருக்குத் துணையாக நிற்கும் நிலையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the highest honor or crowning glory of true friendship. The compound 'வீற்றிருக்கை' (exalted seat or throne) metaphorically represents the ultimate position a friendship can attain. The word 'கொட்பு' can mean spinning or changing, but here it takes the sense of wavering or shifting one's mind, emphasizing steadfast loyalty. 'ஒல்லும் வாய்' refers to every possible opportunity or means. Thus, the pinnacle of friendship is the unwavering, constant commitment to support a friend in every possible way.
